title: Repair standalone packaged callback storage and live delivery
objective: Fix the proven B857 live-canary failure. The packaged VSIX runtime contains aiworkhub but not repository AITools/taskdb.py; callback_bridge._taskdb_module therefore raises during dispatcher construction and the extension silently ignores the returned start_failed payload. Move the complete durable callback outbox/batch authority required by CallbackBridge into the standalone aiworkhub package on the same canonical repository-local .aiworkhub/tasking/task_queue.sqlite, remove every operational AITools/taskdb dependency from packaged runtime, make extension startup surface start_failed, and prove delivery from an extracted VSIX/runtime with no AITools directory anywhere on sys.path. Preserve the pending B858 review callback for the coordinator canary; do not supersede or fabricate it.
acceptance: No production file under src/aiworkhub imports taskdb, AITools.taskdb, computes an AITools path, or requires the parent repository for callback operation.

The standalone aiworkhub callback store owns the required outbox and batch schema plus enqueue, claim/lease, supersede, busy defer, transient failure, delivered, dead-letter, stats and restart recovery operations used by CallbackBridge.
All callback operations resolve exactly the initialized repository's canonical .aiworkhub/tasking/task_queue.sqlite through task_store/storage registry; no fallback or second database is created.
Existing queue rows and schema are upgraded additively and remain readable; the pending B858 callback is neither deleted nor rewritten by migration.
CallbackBridge uses the package-local callback store directly and retains compact payload, batching, acknowledgement, retry/backoff, active-turn parking and Claude/Codex transport semantics.
The VS Code MCP handshake treats an ok response with dispatcher_started=false or status=start_failed as a visible failure, records the bounded diagnostic and does not claim callback readiness.

A black-box test copies/extracts only the packaged runtime into an isolated temporary directory, removes repository root and AITools from sys.path, initializes a fresh repo, creates a terminal callback, starts the dispatcher with a deterministic fake transport and observes pending-to-delivered with a matching acknowledgement.
A packaged-runtime test also proves an invalid/unsupported transport remains pending/fail-closed rather than delivered or dead-lettered accidentally.
Existing B856/B857 callback tests and canonical task-engine tests are rebased to package-local authority and pass without monkeypatching AITools/taskdb.DEFAULT_DB.
VSIX contains callback_store.py and its runtime can import/construct CallbackBridge using only bundled files plus Python standard library/runtime dependencies.
Worker performs no commit, push, extension install or manual mutation of the live B858 outbox; it stops at taskctl review for Codex.
validation: cd tools/geoai-task-mcp && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_aiworkhub_standalone_callback_store_b859.py tests/test_aiworkhub_callback_dispatcher_lifecycle_b857.py tests/test_aiworkhub_claude_callback_transport_b856.py tests/test_aiworkhub_callback_stale_turn_recovery_b823_v1.py tests/test_aiworkhub_canonical_task_engine_b852.py tests/test_callback_bridge.py tests/test_server_runtime_wiring.py
